data.map_policy: common saved maps only; no older-map replacement
data.trigger_unit: same eligible9Hz logged decision opportunity; logged busy/alignment/recovery/repair/cooldown schedule held common
data.map_priority: actual condition snapshot if recorded, otherwise same-control-tick snapshot

TRIG.t_ref: first observed occupied entry in forward rectangle; known first_occupied tick backdated only if cell already in the base forward rectangle at birth; otherwise first common available entry
TRIG.association: 4-connected observed occupied sets associate earliest t_ref/distance; 5-cell threshold on full rectangle, no extra component minimum
TRIG.baseline_direction: displacement over [t_ref-3s,t_ref], <0.3m uses t_ref heading; unavailable uses original A direction
TRIG.guard: angle of baseline u_ref (3s displacement or heading fallback) vs10s displacement both ending at t_ref >90deg AND10s distance>=0.3m ->10s; otherwise baseline
TRIG.no_progress: current3s projected motion<0.20m OR current component fixed-cell minimum-distance drop<0.10m

oracle_geometry: same rule u_ref rectangle1.0x0.4m, physical polygons, active spawns only; existing recorded passage is not undone on return
reference: Topomap photographed world poses joined as a polyline; nearest-projection tangent

TRIG_gate.box_recall: TRIG fires at >=95% of same-tick original-fired BOX_AHEAD opportunities
TRIG_gate.direction: TRIG fraction angle>90deg <=0.5*original fraction; STATIC_AHEAD excluded from all gates

TOPO_H.update: r>=H: H=r,c=0; r<H: c+=1; at c>=3 H=r,c=0
TOPO_H.behind: subgoal reference s < robot reference s -0.2m
TOPO_H.ahead: subgoal index > nearest physical Topomap node index +2
TOPO_H.gate: failure behind upper<=0.5 original; success behind and ahead upper increases<=0.02

next_stage: Only if TRIG OFFLINE_OK; add TOPO-H only if TOPO_OK, otherwise TRIG alone

requested_online.decision: PROMISING iff variant goals>OURS AND collisions<=OURS

technical_correction.reason: Implementation correction: compare final baseline u_ref (including heading fallback when3s displacement<0.3m) with10s direction, not raw short3s displacement
